title: Michael Levin: Consciousness, Biology, Universal Mind, Emergence, Cancer Research
summary: Curt Jaimungal interviews biologist Michael Levin of Tufts about consciousness, bioelectricity, emergence, and cancer research. The conversation challenges reductionist views of life.
why: HN recommends it as a fascinating, mind-expanding interview on bioelectricity and non-reductionist biology.

quote.text: This podcast will be a shocking experience for anyone who still holds reductionist views on life.
